items.definition:
a chemical element, a noble gas
Argon is often used in fluorescent lighting.

great surprise or amazement
He looked at her in astonishment.

the part of a computer system or application that is not directly accessed by the user
The backend processes all the data requests.

a supply of money
He used his entire bankroll to start the business.

the beans from which chocolate is made
Cacao beans are the main ingredient in chocolate.

a type of West Indian music
The band played lively calypso music at the festival.

a playful leap or a mischievous act
The children's caper involved sneaking extra cookies from the jar.

the part of a road intended for vehicles
The accident blocked both lanes of the carriageway.

a wedge or block used to prevent movement
He placed a chock under the wheel to stop the car from rolling.

a device for converting gas or vapor into liquid
The air conditioner uses a condenser to cool the air.

a type of flowering plant
She planted colorful dahlias in her garden.

a game or match that decides the winner of a series
The final game will be the decider for the championship.

a goal or point that makes the scores equal
The team scored an equaliser in the final minutes of the game.

the national police force of the Republic of Ireland
The Garda are investigating the incident.

an old man (often used informally or disparagingly)
The old geezer was telling stories about his youth.

something worn on the head
The construction worker wore protective headgear.

electricity generated by the force of moving water
Many countries rely on hydropower for their energy needs.

the inability to read or write
The government launched a campaign to combat illiteracy.

a device for injecting a fluid
The mechanic replaced the faulty fuel injector.

a plant in the pea family; a pod or seed of such a plant
Beans and lentils are types of legumes.

the act of looking up information; a reference
The database provides a quick lookup for customer details.

a plant of the pea family, or a character name
The garden was full of colorful lupin flowers.

a person who acts as an intermediary between two parties
We cut out the middleman to reduce costs.

a type of fungus that grows on surfaces in damp conditions
There was mildew growing on the shower curtain.

A tool for cracking nuts.
My grandmother uses an old wooden nutcracker to open walnuts.

A person who makes a formal application to a court or other body.
The petitioner presented their case to the judge.

A hard, aromatic fruit resembling a large yellow apple.
She made a delicious jam from the quinces in her garden.

a simultaneous discharge of artillery or other guns
The ship fired a salvo of missiles at the target.

a person who unlawfully occupies an uninhabited building or unused land
The police evicted the squatters from the abandoned building.

a small Spanish savory dish, typically eaten as a snack with drinks
We ordered several different tapas to share.

a large building divided into separate apartments or flats
Many immigrants lived in crowded tenements in the city.

a serious bacterial disease causing muscle spasms
He received a tetanus shot after stepping on a rusty nail.

a mythical bird of Native American culture
The thunderbird is a powerful symbol in some indigenous cultures.

The upper front part of a boot or shoe.
The cobbler replaced the worn vamp of the old shoe.

The state of being married; matrimony.
They lived together for years before finally entering into wedlock.

The state or quality of being adequate; sufficiency.
They questioned the adequacy of the safety measures.

A person or organization that adopts something or someone.
The new technology found many early adopters.

The broadcasting of a recording on radio or television.
The new song received a lot of airplay on pop radio stations.

A ring-shaped coral reef or island.
The small boat sailed into the lagoon of the atoll.

neighborhood (often referring to a Spanish-speaking one)
We walked through the lively barrio, enjoying the music and food.

a small mark or flaw that spoils the appearance of something
The antique table had a few minor blemishes.

a practitioner of chiropractic
I visited a chiropractor for my back pain.

a member of a council
The city councilor addressed the concerns of the residents.

the act of abandoning a person or cause
The soldier was charged with desertion.

the process of making persistent demands for payment of a debt
The company initiated a dunning process for overdue accounts.

the zealous advocacy of a cause, especially Christianity
His passion for the product bordered on evangelism.

injury to body tissues caused by exposure to extreme cold
Hikers need to be careful to avoid frostbite in cold weather.

a prolonged period of abnormally hot weather
The country is experiencing a severe heatwave this summer.

to educate a child at home instead of at school
Many parents choose to homeschool their children for various reasons.

an artist who paints in the style of Impressionism
Monet is considered a master impressionist painter.

a small picture or map inserted within the border of a larger one
The map included an inset showing a detailed view of the city center.

A soldier armed with a lance
The lancer charged across the field, his weapon poised.

The larva of a fly
The rotten fruit was full of maggots.

A person who controls or influences others deviously
He was known as a skilled manipulator, always getting his way.

A unit of length equal to one millionth of a meter
A human hair is about 50 microns thick.

A person who oppresses another
The people rose up against their oppressor.

a type of edible marine fish
We had baked pollack for dinner last night.

a person or thing that pounds; a unit of weight or force
He ordered a quarter-pounder burger for lunch.

the quality of being predictable
The predictability of the weather allowed us to plan our trip.

a group of five people or things, especially musicians
The jazz quintet played a fantastic set at the club.

an act of rolling over; the transfer of funds or a debt
The lottery jackpot had a rollover this week.

the system of sewers
The city is investing in new sewerage infrastructure.

the quality or state of being smooth
The artist admired the smoothness of the marble.

a track for trams or a system of trams
The city is planning to extend its tramway network.
